tools.quote: UHI recommends that you only use the GAI tools that have already been approved for learning and teaching. These tools/sites have undergone various checks to ensure they are not malicious and do not breach security requirements
there are many fake GAI tools/sites designed to capture your information, passwords, and put malware on your device. Never use your UHI password to register for any external service.
